module_purpose: Deep Solver — long-running, local-only autonomous coding agent.
responsibilities: Deep Solver — long-running, local-only autonomous coding agent.

public_api.name: is_running
public_api.description: True if a Deep Solver run is currently active in this process.

public_api.name: submit_user_message
public_api.description:
Feed a mid-run user message into the live Deep loop.

Returns True if the message was queued (run is active), False otherwise
(caller should start a new run or behave normally).

public_api.name: list_checkpoints
public_api.description: Return all live deep checkpoints (newest first).
